question: Does supervising all action pairs improve selected native cost over PP-linked pair supervision under common design, weights and selection?

development.labels: original 450-second native one-action-then-PP cost; all 100 groups, not only nine timeline cases
development.cost_unit: 450-second mean network halted vehicles per controlled lane; lower is better

features.state: PAIRWISE_CAUSAL_STATE_PARENTS + HISTORY_STATE_NAMES, same order as history80
features.action: PAIRWISE_CAUSAL_ACTION_PARENTS + META_ACTION_FEATURES + HISTORY_ACTION_NAMES, same order as history80
features.history: Reuse original joined history bank, including frozen legacy B100 prediction columns; exclude six downstream phase columns.

common_training_design.rows: All 56 ordered a!=b edges for each of the 80 training groups; 4480 rows per fold, identical row order in S and A.
common_training_design.y: absolute_cost(a)-absolute_cost(b), equivalently interval_cost(a)-interval_cost(b); no group-range normalization
common_training_design.S: Only 14 directed edges touching PP have weight W_g/14; all other edges have weight zero.
common_training_design.A: All 56 directed edges have weight W_g/56.
common_training_design.normalization: Use these weights directly; no subsequent mean-row-weight normalization.
common_training_design.binning: Use complete common training-fold X in both arms; no held-out rows. In sklearn 1.7.2 zero-weight rows affect binning and sample counts.

model.leaf_count_choice: 160/4480=20/560 preserves original raw-row fraction. Common row count constraints are not equal positive-weight or independent-group support.
model.fits: Two arms x original five whole-seed folds. Reuse cached history80 OOF records without refitting.

prediction.selection: Use V158 _select_row: full candidate argmin; tolerance 1e-12 tie prefers PP, otherwise first original row. Nonnegative minimum returns PP. Selected stay while PP switches returns PP without second-best search.
prediction.uncertainty: No q90, cycle, support, alpha or beta enters selection. Training diagnostic is weighted MAE only; it is not held-out selected-action calibration.

analysis.gate: All three paired 95% upper bounds below zero, and A raw harmful-cost sum no greater than both S and history80. All must pass; no winner selection among arms.
report: S versus history80 descriptively as bridge context

execution_requirements: Confirm original 100-group, 800-row joins and reference costs; verify each train fold has the common 4480 rows and total/domain/group weights above. Stop on mismatch, without dropping groups.
limits: Exploratory reused development labels; derived action pairs are not new independent outcomes.

S is a bridge model, not an equivalent implementation of history80. The contrast changes supervised edge weights under common design/count constraints; it does not equalize leaf Hessians or independent-group support.
Prediction tests only candidate-versus-PP differences; it does not test all-opponent aggregation.
Training remains equal-domain; reporting remains equal-seed with demand mix 4/3/3. Preserve and disclose this shared distinction.
closure: On failure, HOLD without feature, weight, threshold, leaf-size or fold tuning. A pass supports preparing independent validation only; no automatic closed-loop expansion.
